Subject: RFI for SI-CM-0008 — supporting evidence requested

Hello,

Thank you for your packet for SI-CM-0008. Please send supporting evidence for the following items:

1. 1.internal_audit — internal audit program: procedure and recent audit records.
2. 1.capa — documented corrective-action (CAPA) process, with example records.
3. 1.calibration — gauge calibration program covering production gauges, with calibration records.
4. 2.pfmea — current process FMEA for this part.
5. 2.spc — SPC in use on the CTQs now: control charts and reaction plan.
6. 5.lot_trace — lot or serial traceability to raw material, with a sample trace record.
7. 5.nc_segregation — procedure and records for identifying and segregating nonconforming material.
8. 8.flowdown — evidence that requirements are flowed down to the sub-tier supplier.

Stark Industries Supplier Quality — Pepper Potts

audit_plan.question: Walk all stations building SI-CM-0008: verify the open major ESD finding (reliability_report.md §1.2, 1 open vs limit 0), its corrective action and the status of the ESD control program.
Review the FPY records behind the 5 consecutive months reported (reliability_report.md §1.3); confirm the data source and when a sixth month (rfq limit >= 6) will be available.
Trace one shipped unit back to raw-material lots to confirm the lot traceability claimed in quality_manual.md §1.7, and review the supporting records.
